evidence_role: prospectively specified supplementary literature-based baseline comparison; separate from the original V11 formal protocol and Table 3

parameter_matched_constrained_bf_noilc.label: Parameter-matched constrained basis-function NOILC
parameter_matched_constrained_bf_noilc.description: a literature-grounded norm-optimal ILC baseline adapted to the same basis and command constraints used in this study
parameter_matched_constrained_bf_noilc.parameter_matching_rationale: hold optimizer regularization and smoothing fixed so the comparison does not introduce baseline-specific tuning after observing formal outcomes
parameter_matched_constrained_bf_noilc.basis: endpoint-clamped cubic B-spline; 12 nominal control points and 20 active axis coefficients
parameter_matched_constrained_bf_noilc.hard_constraints: same cumulative command-correction, velocity, acceleration, and coefficient bounds as Proposed

plants.seed_audit: not used by prior development, formal, matched-ablation, parameter-sensitivity, or held-out-plant experiments

secondary_metrics: per-update and cumulative issued-command ||Delta u||_2 including rollback
control_effort_definition: 100*(Proposed_effort-BF_NOILC_effort)/BF_NOILC_effort; positive means Proposed uses more effort

inference.primary_interval: hierarchical bootstrap resampling plants and then tasks within sampled plants
inference.superiority_rule: median paired task-AUC effect > 0 and hierarchical 95% CI lower bound > 0
inference.direction_only_rule: median effect > 0 but hierarchical 95% CI crosses zero

claim_boundary: configuration-level comparison; observed differences are not attributed solely to selection, temporal alignment, alpha, or rollback
